card.name: The end of the word protease
card.fires_on: The final piece "ase" of the word "protease", right before "inhibitors". It appears in HIV drug interaction text such as "protease inhibitors (PIs)".

modes.label: Protease before inhibitors
modes.description: The "ase" ending of protease in the phrase "protease inhibitors" in antiretroviral interaction passages.
